place.name: Rillbend Orchard Path
place.description: A narrow public footpath beyond Thistlebell Yard, threading between old apple orchards and a shallow drainage rill. Moss-dark stone culverts carry rainwater beneath the trail; a wooden handrail crosses the lowest bend.
place.culture: Asterwyn Orchard Vales; walkers share the path with farm workers, orchard carts on the nearby road and seasonal beasts passing through hedgerows.
place.note: Known descriptions and associations are not proof that a person is physically present, agrees to speak, has a resource or belongs to a group.

hud.name: Maddoc Maddren
hud.weather: Cool and clear, with thin mist between the orchard trees
focus: Attend to the burden beast's rubbed shoulder

recap:
CAMPAIGN: Maddoc Maddren (seed 3951775931)
SCENE: At Thistlebell Yard, Maddoc rebuked the arguing handlers, then approached the burden beast's twisted left-shoulder harness. Moving carefully, he freed the pinching strap and straightened it without removing the full harness. The beast held steady, flicked an ear and shifted weight more comfortably. The two handlers are now watching; the beast has not yet resumed hauling.
PC: young learner, undecided; 0 S
JOURNAL: A place is established in the lived world: Thistlebell Yard. | At first bell, Thistlebell Yard is already awake. Barley carts creak along the orchard road; the smell of bruised apples drifts from the presses, and water beads on the harness rails. Ten-year-old Maddoc Maddren is beside the public trough, where an ash-coated burden beast has planted all four feet and refuses to move. Two adult handlers argue in low voices about whether it has been overworked. Neither reaches for the animal. Beyond the yard, canal bells sound for the morning barges. | A place is established in the lived world: Rillbend Orchard Path.
